topic: Beginner mistake: using one giant chat for everything (and 3 habits that fix it)
post:
Do you keep ONE Claude chat open for everything? 🧵
It's one of the most common beginner mistakes.

Here's why.
Every chat has a context window: the amount of information Claude can work with in a single conversation.

When one chat mixes your budget, your emails and your vacation plans, two things happen:
😵 Old, unrelated details can muddy new answers
⏳ According to Claude's help center, longer conversations use more of your usage limit

3 simple habits that fix it 👇

1️⃣ New topic, new chat
Switching from a report to a recipe? Start fresh.

2️⃣ Batch related questions
Claude's own guide suggests combining related questions into one message instead of lots of back-and-forth.

3️⃣ Carry over a summary, not the whole history
Before you switch, ask:
"Summarize what we decided in 5 bullet points so I can start a new chat."
Then paste those bullets into the new chat.

Why it matters:
Short, focused chats keep Claude's answers sharp and your usage in check. It's like clearing your desk before starting a new project. 🧹

How many chats do you have open right now? Be honest. 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
